actions.name: Parse Text to Task
actions.description: Convert natural language text into a structured task
actions.promptTemplate: Convert the following text into a task object: {text}. Context: {context}. Return JSON with title, description, dueDate (ISO), priority, tags.

actions.name: Categorize Transaction
actions.promptTemplate: Categorize transaction: merchant={merchant}, amount={amount}, description={description}. Return category (e.g., Food, Transportation, Entertainment).

actions.name: Generate Email Reply
actions.description: Generate a professional email reply based on context
actions.promptTemplate: Generate email reply to: {originalEmail}. Tone: {tone}. Key points to include: {keyPoints}.

actions.name: Summarize Notes
actions.description: Create a concise summary of markdown notes
actions.promptTemplate: Summarize the following notes in {maxLength} words: {content}. Extract key points and action items.

actions.name: Suggest Meeting Agenda
actions.description: Create a meeting agenda based on participants and topic
actions.promptTemplate: Create a meeting agenda for topic: {topic}, participants: {participants}, duration: {duration} minutes.
